calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT p.sku, w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.sku, r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS web_net_sales,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-01') AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-01') AS web_lines,

 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS dispatched_no_ts,

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sold AS (
    SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
),
ret_all AS (
    -- all refunds on web-sold lines wherever processed, return date from migration
    SELECT p.sku, -r.refund_net AS v
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE fs.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
),
alt AS (
    SELECT sku, SUM(v) AS alt_net FROM (SELECT * FROM sold UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ret_all) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(alt_net,2) AS alt_net,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount),2) FROM fact_sales_line f2 JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=f2.product_key WHERE p2.category='ZZ Test' AND f2.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND f2.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900)) AS zz_test_web_net
FROM alt JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = alt.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY alt_net DESC LIMIT 12
